title: Suzu Travels — First time in India? 5 things to know

headline: First time
in *India?
scenes.sub: 5 things to know before you book

items.b: India e-Visa: 30 days, 1 year or 5 years. Apply at least 4 days before you fly.
Cool, dry and golden across most of India. Himalayas: April to June.
Fly between regions. Drive within them — with a private driver.
A DMC handles hotels, driver, guides and 24/7 support — one WhatsApp number.
5–7 days for one region. 12–14 days for two. Slow is better.
